name: 06-layers
description: An effect, a modifier reshaping it, and a second layer doing the same, blended over the first.

steps.title: Layers
steps.description: Effects, modifiers, and what blends between them
steps.caption: Layers. Blending, and what sits between the effect and the lights.
Everything that paints lives here, under a layer. An effect, and anything that reshapes what it draws.
Clearing what is there first, so we start from an empty layer and build it up in front of you.
An effect paints into its layer's own buffer. This one is bouncing balls, and it knows nothing about the shape it lands on.
Now a modifier. It reshapes what the effect drew, on the way to the lights, and the effect never knows it happened.
Same balls, folded down the middle. I changed the mapping, not the effect: the two are kept apart on purpose.
Blending happens between layers rather than inside one, so here is a second layer stacked on the first.
It gets its own effect, painting into its own buffer, completely independent of the one below it.
And its own modifier, because each layer is reshaped on its own terms rather than sharing one setting.
The drivers composite the layers from the bottom up, and opacity says how much of this one lands on top of the other.
Two effects, two modifiers, one wall. Every piece of that is a module you can add, remove or swap while it runs.
